author: ojiudezue
title: Step 8 arrival actions simplified: play in your own room and wait; hand off to music following
summary: The step 8 plan's arrival engine reasoned about which room counts as 'your room right after you got home' through near-room rules (adjacency, approach hall, same zone), an occupied-lead timer and per-source arrival gates. The operator replaced it: on a confirmed arrival, start the person's pick in their own room and wait; if they reach it within 15 minutes it keeps playing until a manual stop, otherwise it stops; once they are in the room it hands off to music following (follows only if their music following is on). It does not start when another tracked person or a guest is already in that room. Welcome scenes are own-room only for v6.0.0; follow-you-for-15-min becomes an option. The People settings screen ships first so profiles can be set while the engine is built.
why: D0 showed the near rules passing only 16-59% of real Master Bedroom entries, the 120 s occupied-lead blocking people on their own motion (which leads BLE by 3-7 min), and BLE arrivals never passing the counted-return gate. Each fix added state and edge cases. Playing in the person's room and letting music following own movement removes the near-room logic, the per-room timing and most of the arrival state, which the operator named directly: 'That way we don't have too much state to track.'
alternatives_considered: Near-room rule C (same house zone, 34% for the Master Bedroom) or D (a separate approach-room list)
Follow-you from the first room with a speaker for 15 min (kept as an option)
Welcome scenes wherever the arrival leads (deferred: 'Long run. Let's nail the room first')
implications: D2/D3 need a plan revision before build: no near rules, own-room start, a 15-minute arrive-or-stop window, hand-off to music following, occupied rule by other tracked person + guest detection. The BLE-vs-geofence trigger split is under re-check because person.* home may already compose GPS, router and BLE trackers, which would make the D0 split two views of one arrival.
revisit_trigger: Operator asks for follow-you or anywhere-the-arrival-leads scenes, or the own-room start fires into rooms people do not reach within 15 min more than rarely.
operator_quote: The simplest thing is play in your room and just wait for you to arrive
